name: Project Reveal
title: Project Reveal
description: A compact project list that smoothly expands each row into an image-led detail card with configurable GSAP spring motion.
summary: The thumbnail, title, and metadata travel from their list positions into a centered card. The description fades in as the card settles, and closing returns every element to the original row. Tune stiffness, damping, mass, speed, dimensions, and backdrop to fit your portfolio.
highlights: Continuous thumbnail-to-card expansion and return to the original row
Damped spring easing with configurable stiffness, damping, and mass
Independent closing speed and interruptible motion
Viewport-aware sizing with stacked detail cards on narrow screens
Radix focus containment, Escape dismissal, and focus restoration
Live motion presets and appearance controls in the component studio
A shared spring-driven hover highlight glides between rows and follows keyboard focus
anatomy: <ProjectRevealPanel> portaled image, heading, metadata, and description

physics.description: An analytical damped spring response drives the card geometry and shared elements on a scoped GSAP timeline. Description and backdrop use coordinated opacity tweens. Closing starts from the current geometry, including when opening is interrupted.

accessibility.aria: Each project has a named button. The modal has a title, focus containment, and returns focus to the selected row after the exit animation.

keyboard.description: Navigate project rows or controls within the active dialog.
Open a focused project or activate the close button.

accessibility.reducedMotion: Respects prefers-reduced-motion, skips movement and fades, and retains all dialog interactions.

recommended: Portfolio project indexes and editorial work sections
Image-led case studies with a short description
bestPractices: Provide unique, stable project ids and useful imageAlt text.
Use high-resolution portrait images for a sharp expansion.
Pass your own items and href values; omit href when no project page exists.
Start with the smooth preset and adjust damping before adding overshoot.

props.name: items
props.description: Projects with a unique id, title, category, year, image, and description. Optional imageAlt, imagePosition, href, and content customize each detail card.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring stiffness, clamped to 80–800. Higher values settle faster.

props.name: damping
props.description: Spring damping, clamped to 12–80. Lower values add overshoot; higher values soften it.

props.name: mass
props.description: Spring mass, clamped to 0.25–3. Higher values give the card more weight.

props.name: speed
props.description: Global motion speed, clamped to 0.25–3. Applies to opening and closing.

props.name: closeSpeed
props.description: Additional closing speed multiplier, clamped to 0.5–2.

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Expanded card corner radius in pixels, clamped to 0–32.

props.name: thumbnailSize
props.description: Thumbnail width in pixels, clamped to 24–64. The portrait height is 1.25 times the width.

props.name: modalWidth
props.description: Maximum card width in pixels, clamped to 320–1400 and constrained to the viewport.

props.name: imageRatio
props.description: Image proportion of the desktop card width, clamped to 0.3–0.6. Narrow cards stack vertically.

props.name: overlayOpacity
props.description: Backdrop opacity, clamped to 0–0.8.

props.name: hoverDuration
props.description: Hover highlight travel duration in seconds, clamped to 0.1–0.8. The same highlight follows pointer and keyboard focus, with spring easing and a soft exit fade.

props.name: hoverClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the shared row hover highlight.

props.name: showYear
props.description: Show the year in both the list and detail card.

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.description: Allow dismissal by clicking outside the card. Escape and the close button remain available.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Label of the optional project link, displayed only when the selected item has an href.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the project list.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional project list classes.

props.name: rowClassName
props.description: Additional classes for every project trigger.

props.name: modalClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the portaled detail card.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the project on opening and null when closing begins.
